title: November Twenty-Six — EN/ES/FR (Pete McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
November twenty-six, the year was good
A baby came into the neighbourhood
Biggest one we'd seen in quite some time
Wilma said — this boy is going to be fine

[Verse 2 — Español]
Los años pasaron, creció en sus botas [Years went by, he grew into his boots]
El hijo mayor no necesita las notas [The oldest son doesn't need the notes]
Rugby en invierno, sol sobre la bahía [Rugby in winter, sun out on the bay]
Cincuenta y algo ahora pero sigue de la misma manera [Fifty-something now but still that same old way]

[Chorus — English]
November twenty-six, raise a glass
To the one who always showed the rest what class
Pete Capitán, the first one through the door
Happy birthday to the one who set the floor

[Bridge — Français]
Le vingt-six novembre — levez un verre [November twenty-six — raise a glass]
Au premier fils, à celui qui sait faire [To the first son, to the one who knows how]
Pete Capitán, toujours en tête [Pete Capitán, always ahead]
Joyeux anniversaire — bonne fête [Happy birthday — good celebration]

[Verse 3 — English]
Pelican out on the water calm and sure
Same man every morning, nothing to prove more

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
Happy birthday Pete
Feliz cumpleaños Pete [Happy birthday Pete]
Joyeux anniversaire Pete [Happy birthday Pete]
That's my boy
